Aiuen, The Elf-Gate Key Rune.name: 艾厄恩，精灵门钥符文 Aiuen, The Elf-Gate Key Rune
Aiuen, The Elf-Gate Key Rune.description:
用法 绘制于一名生物

这枚精妙的环形符文是横贯诸星的精灵门 aiudara 网络的钥匙。每轮一次，当符文携带者执行行走动作时，他们可以改为传送一段等同于其速度的距离。

激发 你将符文携带者传送至与你任一其他符文邻接的位置，只要其位于同一位面。非自愿目标可以尝试一次 @Check[will|against:runesmith] 豁免以抵抗此次传送。

特殊 若你拥有施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.AUctDF2fqPZN2w4W]{Sigil} 戏法的能力，那么除你的任一符文外，你还可以使用艾厄恩的激发将符文携带者传送至与你位于同一位面的任一印记邻接的位置。

Usage drawn on a creature

This masterful circular rune is key to the aiudara network of elf gates that stretch across the stars. Once per turn, when the rune-bearer takes a Stride action, they can instead teleport a distance equal to their Speed.

Invocation You teleport the rune-bearer to a location adjacent to any of your other runes, as long as it is on the same plane. An unwilling target can attempt a @Check[will|against:runesmith] save to resist this teleportation.

Special If you have the ability to cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.AUctDF2fqPZN2w4W]{Sigil} cantrip, then you can use aiuen's invocation to teleport the rune bearer to a location adjacent to any of your sigils on the same plane, in addition to any of your runes.

Inth-, Diacritic Rune of Corruption.name: 阴思-，腐化修饰符文 Inth-, Diacritic Rune of Corruption
Inth-, Diacritic Rune of Corruption.description:
用法 绘制在一个符文上

基础符文周围的这组棱角分明的修饰传递着魔族腐化的精髓。基础符文和它造成的任何伤害都会获得邪秽特征。如果该符文应用于圣洁生物，该生物在符文应用期间陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.OwbpgxdQFpxfre4g]{Effect: Inth-, Diacritic Rune of Corruption}

激发（邪秽） 当激发基础符文时，它会在目标身上燃烧起邪恶的黑火。除了基础符文的正常效果外，目标还会受到 1d4 持续火焰伤害。

等级（+2） 伤害提升 1d4。

Usage drawn on a rune

This set of angular accents around the base rune channels the essence of fiendish corruption. The base rune gains the unholy trait, as does any damage it deals. If applied to a holy creature, that creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for as long as the rune is applied to it.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.OwbpgxdQFpxfre4g]{Effect: Inth-, Diacritic Rune of Corruption}

Invocation (unholy) When the base rune is invoked, it burns away in unholy black fire that lingers on its target. In addition to the base rune's normal effect, the target takes 1d4 persistent fire damage.

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d4.

Sun-, Diacritic Rune of Preservation.name: 桑-，存续修饰符文 Sun-, Diacritic Rune of Preservation
Sun-, Diacritic Rune of Preservation.description:
用法 绘制在一个符文上

这处螺旋状的修饰能将符文的魔力向外引导，然后再回到同一位置，使符文得以重组。在基础符文被激发后，符文会自动描画自身回到同一目标。

特殊 你在给定的时间内只能应用一个 桑-，存续修饰符文，并且一旦激发，你在10分钟内不能再次蚀刻或描画它。

Usage drawn on a rune

This spiraling diacritic channels the magic of a rune outwards, then back to the same location, allowing a rune to reconstitute itself. After the base rune is invoked, the rune automatically Traces itself back upon the same target.

Special You can have only one copy of sun-, diacritic rune of preservation applied at a given time, and once you invoke it, you cannot Etch or Trace it again for 10 minutes.

Trolistri, Rune of Forlorn Sorrow.name: 特罗里斯翠，惆怅忧郁符文 Trolistri, Rune of Forlorn Sorrow
Trolistri, Rune of Forlorn Sorrow.description:
用法 蚀刻在护甲或一个生物上

这个符文让人联想到精灵的惆怅天性，以及其中蕴含的美感。虽然这个符文很美，但悲伤最好从远处欣赏，不要靠近。符文携带者 20 尺范围内的敌人会将他们与符文携带者之间的所有方格视为困难地形。

激发 悲伤会抹去进行任何其他动作的能力。符文携带者 20 尺范围内的每个敌人都必须成功通过一次 @Check[will|against:runesmith] 豁免，否则就会在其下个回合因花费第一个动作来啜泣而陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}（如果大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}）。无论结果如何，该生物都会临时免疫此激发 1 小时。

Usage etched onto armor or a creature

This rune calls to mind the forlorn nature of elves, and the beauty within it. While this rune is beautiful, sorrow is best admired from a distance, discouraging approach. Enemies within 20 feet of the rune-bearer treat all squares between them and the rune-bearer as difficult terrain.

Invocation Sorrow blots out the capacity for any other action. Each enemy within 20 feet of the rune-bearer must succeed at a @Check[will|against:runesmith] saving throw or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} as it spends the first action of its next turn sobbing (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} on a critical failure). Regardless of the outcome, the creature is then temporarily immune to this invocation for 1 hour.

Esvadir, Rune of Whetstones.name: 伊斯瓦迪尔，砥石符文 Esvadir, Rune of Whetstones
Esvadir, Rune of Whetstones.description:
用法 绘制在一件穿刺或挥砍武器或无武装打击上

将这个锯齿状符文置于刀刃上，可确保刀刃永不变钝。在成功打击时，武器造成每武器伤害骰额外 2 持续流血伤害。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.Bq9YEJ6OvXHgE8j4]{Effect: Esvadir, Rune of Whetstones}

激发 锋利的精粹从符文中释放出来，对符文携带者相邻的一个生物造成 @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level / 2)))d6[slashing]] 伤害，进行 @Check[fortitude|basic|against:runesmith] 豁免。

等级（+2） 激发的伤害增加 2d6。

Usage drawn on a piercing or slashing weapon or unarmed Strike

This serrated rune, when placed on a blade, ensures it will never go dull. On a successful Strike, the weapon deals an additional 2 persistent bleed damage per weapon damage die.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.Bq9YEJ6OvXHgE8j4]{Effect: Esvadir, Rune of Whetstones}

Invocation The essence of sharpness is released outwards from the rune, dealing @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level / 2)))d6[slashing]] damage to a creature adjacent to the rune-bearer, with a @Check[fortitude|basic|against:runesmith] save.

Level (+2) The damage of the invocation increases by 2d6.

Marssyl, Rune of Impact.name: 马瑟尔，冲击符文 Marssyl, Rune of Impact
Marssyl, Rune of Impact.description:
用法 绘制在一件钝击武器或无武装打击上

当力量穿过符文的同心环时，会被放大数倍。武器造成每武器骰 1 点钝击溅射伤害。如果武器是近战武器，符文携带者免疫此溅射伤害。

激发 武器会随着威力的集中而震动。在武器持用者的下个回合结束前，使用该武器进行的下一次成功打击会造成额外一个伤害骰，目标必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|against:class] 豁免对抗你的职业 DC，否则会被向后直线推离 10 尺，如果大失败则会被推离 20 尺。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.cX8MV4n6mF7RmXTp]{Effect: Marssyl, Rune of Impact}

Usage drawn on a bludgeoning weapon or unarmed Strike

This rune magnifies force many times over as it passes through the rune's concentric rings. The weapon deals 1 bludgeoning splash damage per weapon damage die. If the weapon is a melee weapon, the rune-bearer is immune to this splash damage.

Invocation The weapon vibrates as power concentrates within it. The next successful Strike made with the weapon before the end of its wielder's next turn deals an additional die of damage and the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC or be pushed 10 feet in a straight line backwards, or 20 feet on a critical failure.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.cX8MV4n6mF7RmXTp]{Effect: Marssyl, Rune of Impact}

Atryl, Rune of Fire.name: 阿崔尔，火之符文 Atryl, Rune of Fire
Atryl, Rune of Fire.description:
用法 绘制在一个生物或物体上

这个符文通常被放置在壁炉中的石头上，以确保炉火不会在夜间熄灭，它的力量甚至可以使石头燃烧。携带者的火焰抗力（如果有的话）降低 6。其免疫不受影响。

激发 携带者受到 @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level / 2)))d6[fire]] 伤害，进行 @Check[fortitude|basic|against:runesmith] 豁免；如果大失败，他陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} 1 轮。

等级（+2） 火焰抗力减少量增加 1，激发的伤害增加 2d6。

Usage drawn on a creature or object

This rune is often placed on a stone in a hearth to ensure a fire does not go out in the night, its power enabling even stone to burn. The bearer's fire resistance, if any, is reduced by 6. Its immunities are unaffected.

Invocation The bearer takes @Damage[(2*(ceil(@actor.level / 2)))d6[fire]] damage, with a @Check[fortitude|basic|against:runesmith] save; on a critical failure, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Level (+2) The reduction in fire resistance increases by 1, and the damage of the invocation increases by 2d6.

Kojastri, Rune of Insulation.name: 科雅斯特里，隔绝符文 Kojastri, Rune of Insulation
Kojastri, Rune of Insulation.description:
用法 绘制在护甲上

该符文可隔绝各种有害能量。穿戴护甲的生物由你选择获得对寒冷、电击或火焰的抗力5，任何触摸到他们或用无武装攻击或非长触及近战武器伤害到他们的生物都会受到2d6伤害。符文具有所选能量类型的特征，并造成该类型的伤害。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.aa9Ncmtrwm1EThms]{Effect: Kojastri, Rune of Insulation}

激发 任何包卷、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}，或活吞符文携带者的生物都会受到 @Damage[(4 + 2*floor((@actor.level - 9) / 4))d6[untyped]] 伤害，进行 @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] 豁免对抗你的职业DC。如果失败，它还会释放护甲穿戴者。

等级（+4） 抗力增加5，伤害提升1d6，激发的伤害增加2d6。

Usage drawn on armor

This rune insulates from harmful energy of all kinds. The creature wearing the armor gains resistance 5 to your choice of cold, electricity, or fire, and any creature that touches them or damages them with an unarmed attack or non-reach melee weapon takes 2d6 damage. The rune has the trait of the energy type chosen and deals damage of that type.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.aa9Ncmtrwm1EThms]{Effect: Kojastri, Rune of Insulation}

Invocation Any creature that has the armor's wearer engulfed, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, or swallowed whole takes @Damage[(4 + 2*floor((@actor.level - 9) / 4))d6[untyped]] damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save against your class DC. On a failure, it also releases the armor's wearer.

Level (+4) The resistance increases by 5, and the damage increases by 1d6, or 2d6 for the invocation.

Ranshu, Rune of Thunder.name: 岚束，雷之符文 Ranshu, Rune of Thunder
Ranshu, Rune of Thunder.description:
用法 绘制在一个生物或物体上

这个垂直的符文通常刻在高塔上，用来吸引闪电并保护塔下的建筑。如果携带者在其回合内没有使用至少一次移动动作，闪电就会在其回合结束时找到它，造成 @Damage[(1d4 + (ceil(@actor.level/2)) - 1)[electricity]]。

激发 最初的闪电编织成一道强大的闪电。符文携带者会受到 @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level / 2))d6[electricity]] 伤害，进行 @Check[fortitude|basic|against:runesmith] 基础强韧豁免。

等级（+2） 伤害增加1，激发的伤害增加2d6。

Usage drawn on a creature or object

This vertical rune is often carved on tall towers to draw lightning and shield the buildings below it. If the bearer does not take a move action at least once on its turn, lightning finds it at the end of its turn, dealing @Damage[(1d4 + (ceil(@actor.level/2)) - 1)[electricity]].

Invocation The preliminary streaks of lightning braid together into a powerful bolt. The rune-bearer takes @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level / 2))d6[electricity]] damage, with a @Check[fortitude|basic|against:runesmith] save.

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1, and the damage of the invocation increases by 2d6.

Oljinex, Rune of Cowards' Bane.name: 奥金奈克斯，懦夫之灾符文 Oljinex, Rune of Cowards' Bane
Oljinex, Rune of Cowards' Bane.description:
用法 绘制在一面盾牌上

这个符文就像一支断箭。当举起盾牌时，它赋予携带者在对抗物理远程攻击上 AC +1 状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.janzhnKlCAeVkYHk]{Effect: Oljinex, Rune of Cowards' Bane}

激发（幻术，心灵，视觉） 符文会在符文携带者相邻的所有生物的脑海中产生一道幻术，持续 1 轮。幻术是一堵无法逾越的大墙，阻挡了离开符文携带者的所有去路。受此激发影响的生物在 1 轮内无法主动远离符文携带者，或者直到他们识破幻术，通常是通过使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} 动作来对抗你的职业 DC。

Usage drawn on a shield

This rune resembles a broken arrow. While the shield is raised, it also grants the bearer a +1 status bonus to AC against physical ranged attacks.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.janzhnKlCAeVkYHk]{Effect: Oljinex, Rune of Cowards' Bane}

Invocation (illusion, mental, visual) The rune creates an illusion in the minds of all creatures adjacent to the rune-bearer that lasts for 1 round. The illusion is of a large impassable wall blocking all paths away from the rune-bearer. Creatures affected by this invocation can't willing move further away from the rune bearer for 1 round or until they disbelieve the illusion, usually by using a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action against your class DC.

Jurroz, Rune of Dragon Fury.name: 侏罗兹，巨龙之怒符文 Jurroz, Rune of Dragon Fury
Jurroz, Rune of Dragon Fury.description:
用法 蚀刻在一个生物或护甲上

这个棱角分明的符文能引导龙类的愤怒。每当有生物打击符文携带者或偷窃符文携带者的物品时，龙族的制裁就会完全集中在他身上，使其陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}，持续 1 轮。

激发 作为一个自由动作，符文携带者可以朝在过去一分钟内对其造成伤害的生物飞行至多 60 尺。如果他结束移动时与该生物相邻，则该生物会陷入措手不及，直到符文携带者的下个回合结束。如果符文携带者没有飞行速度并在空中结束移动，他会在下个回合结束时安全地飘回地面。

Usage etched onto a creature or armor

This angular rune channels the fury of dragon kind. Whenever a creature Strikes the rune-bearer or Steals from them, draconic sanction fully focuses on them, causing them to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round.

Invocation As a free action, the rune-bearer can Fly up to 60 feet toward a creature that has damaged them in the last minute. If they end this movement adjacent to the creature, the creature becomes off-guard until the end of the rune-bearer's next turn. If the rune-bearer doesn't have a fly Speed and ends its movement in the air, they safely float back to the ground at the end of their next turn.

En-, Diacritic Rune of Expansion.name: 因-，扩散修饰符文 En-, Diacritic Rune of Expansion
En-, Diacritic Rune of Expansion.description:
用法 绘制在一个造成伤害的符文上

这道修饰以朝外的箭头环绕在符文周围，可以放大并向外引导力量。激发基础符文时，其伤害会以符文携带者为中心，应用于 @Template[burst|distance:15] 范围。如果任何生物也在该区域内，他们也会受到基础符文的影响（包括任何豁免）。

Usage drawn on a rune that deals damage

This diacritic surrounds a rune with outward-facing arrows to magnify and direct power outward. When the base rune is invoked, its damage applies in a @Template[burst|distance:15], centered on the rune-bearer. If any creatures are also within the area, they are subject to the base rune's effects (including any saving throw).

Feikris, Rune of Gravity.name: 菲克瑞斯，重力符文 Feikris, Rune of Gravity
Feikris, Rune of Gravity.description:
用法 绘制在一个生物或护甲上

这个符文的线条奇怪地重叠在一起，使它看起来比实际要大。符文携带者的运动检定获得 +2 物品加值，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KxaYlC50zzHysJj8]{Titan Wrestler} 专长的增益。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.s3cil1tttjpA2N7f]{Effect: Feikris, Rune of Gravity}

激发 符文携带者周围 15 尺弥漫范围内的所有生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude] 豁免，否则将被拉向符文携带者 5 尺（大失败时 10 尺）。

等级（17 级） 物品加值提升为 +3。

Usage drawn on a creature or armor

The lines of this rune overlap strangely, making it seem larger than it really is. The rune-bearer gains a +2 item bonus to Athletics checks and gains the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KxaYlC50zzHysJj8]{Titan Wrestler} feat.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.s3cil1tttjpA2N7f]{Effect: Feikris, Rune of Gravity}

Invocation All creatures in a 15-foot emanation around the rune-bearer must succeed at a @Check[fortitude] save or be pulled 5 feet towards the rune-bearer (or 10 feet on a critical failure).

Level (17th) The item bonus increases to +3.

Holtrik, Rune of Dwarven Ramparts.name: 霍特瑞克，矮人城墙符文 Holtrik, Rune of Dwarven Ramparts
Holtrik, Rune of Dwarven Ramparts.description:
用法 绘制在一面盾牌上

这个棱角分明的符文与矮人语中的“城墙”和“盾牌”意思相近，曾经被用于加固隧道，在激烈的战斗中同样适用。携带该符文的盾牌提升 1 点其 AC 的环境加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.gBwMb0QqrBJVzyYc]{Effect: Holtrik, Rune of Dwarven Ramparts}

激发 你呼唤盾牌到正确的位置。你举起携带符文的盾牌，就像符文携带者使用了举起盾牌一样，盾牌维持其增加的 AC 加值直到该生物下回合开始。

Usage drawn on a shield

Similarity in the Dwarven words for "wall" and "shield" ensure that this angular rune, once used to shore up tunnels, can apply equally well in the heat of battle. A shield bearing this rune increases its circumstance bonus to AC by 1.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.gBwMb0QqrBJVzyYc]{Effect: Holtrik, Rune of Dwarven Ramparts}

Invocation You call the shield to its rightful place. You Raise the Shield bearing the rune, as if the rune-bearer had used Raise a Shield, and the shield retains the increased bonus to AC until the beginning of the creature's next turn.

Ichelsu, Rune of Observation.name: 伊切尔苏，观察符文 Ichelsu, Rune of Observation
Ichelsu, Rune of Observation.description:
用法 绘制在一个生物上

该符文是一个由点状圆圈组成的环形，可以让标记了该符文的生物看到一切。目标会受到 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{see the unseen} 的效果，并获得全域视野，这能防止其被夹击。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.uSvACOQ3Ib7d311G]{Effect: Ichelsu, Rune of Observation}

激发 符文的眼睛向外飞出，附着在 20 尺弥漫范围内所有生物上。每个原本 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} 的生物改为变成 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}，而每个因其他原因处于隐蔽的生物都不再隐蔽。此效果持续 2 轮。

Usage drawn on a creature

A ring of dotted circles, this rune allows a creature marked with it to see all. The target is affected by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{see the unseen} and gains all-around vision, which prevents it from being flanked.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.uSvACOQ3Ib7d311G]{Effect: Ichelsu, Rune of Observation}

Invocation The eyes of the rune fly outwards, attaching to all creatures in a 20-foot emanation. Each of these creatures that was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead, and each one that was concealed for any other reason is no longer concealed. This effect lasts for 2 rounds.

Zohk, Rune of Homecoming.name: 宙克，归家符文 Zohk, Rune of Homecoming
Zohk, Rune of Homecoming.description:
用法 绘制在一个生物上

这个圆形记号的目的是让旅行者总能找到回家的路。目标在速度上获得 +15 尺的状态加值，但只有当他们的移动结束比开始更靠近你时才会获得此加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.RE2etiUSVzVOfJOc]{Effect: Zohk, Rune of Homecoming}

激发（传送） 你将符文携带者召唤到你身边。你将目标传送到与你相邻的任何未被占据的方格。如果符文携带者非自愿，他可以尝试一次 @Check[will] 豁免来否决此效果。

Usage drawn on a creature

This circular mark is meant to allow travelers to always find their way home. The target gains a +15-foot status bonus to their Speeds, but only when their movement would end closer to you than they started their turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.RE2etiUSVzVOfJOc]{Effect: Zohk, Rune of Homecoming}

Invocation (teleportation) You call the rune-bearer to your side. You teleport the target to any unoccupied square adjacent to you. If the bearer is unwilling, they can attempt a @Check[will] save to negate the effect.

Pluuna, Rune of Illumination.name: 帕鲁纳，光照符文 Pluuna, Rune of Illumination
Pluuna, Rune of Illumination.description:
用法 绘制在一个生物或护甲上

虽然许多符文都被附魔以发光，但光亮才是这个简易符文的重点。符文在20尺弥漫范围内发出明亮光照（以及40尺内昏暗光照）。弥漫范围内的生物在隐秘检定上受到-1物品减值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.tuGYsi4iaULsHsbf]{Effect: Pluuna, Rune of Illumination}

激发 光照中的每个生物都必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|against:class] 豁免对抗你的职业DC，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} 1轮。光照会消散，但目标仍然会在20尺弥漫范围内发出昏暗光照，持续1轮。

Usage drawn on a creature or armor

While many runes are enchanted to glow, light is the focus of this simple rune. The rune sheds bright light in a 20-foot emanation (and dim light to 40 feet). Creatures in the emanation take a –1 item penalty to Stealth checks.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.tuGYsi4iaULsHsbf]{Effect: Pluuna, Rune of Illumination}

Invocation Each creature in the light must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:class] save against your class DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. The light fades, but the target still sheds dim light in a 20-foot emanation for 1 round.

Ur-, Diacritic Rune of Intensity.name: 乌-，强度修饰符文 Ur-, Diacritic Rune of Intensity
Ur-, Diacritic Rune of Intensity.description:
用法 绘制在一个造成伤害的符文上

这处修饰用更粗的线条突出了基础符文，加重其效果。当基础符文被激发时，其激发在伤害上获得等同于你的智力调整值的状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.MXgAIqOq9toR0qmc]{Effect: Ur-, Diacritic Rune of Intensity}

Usage drawn on a rune that deals damage

This diacritic accentuates the base rune with bolder lines to give greater weight to its effects. When the base rune is invoked, its invocation gains a status bonus to damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.MXgAIqOq9toR0qmc]{Effect: Ur-, Diacritic Rune of Intensity}

Rovan, Seal of the Dead Vault Rune.name: 洛网，死之库封印符文 Rovan, Seal of the Dead Vault Rune
Rovan, Seal of the Dead Vault Rune.description:
用法 绘制于一名生物

这枚雄浑而锋利的符文是将毁灭者封印于其囚牢之中——位于戈拉理安核心深处——的众多符文之一。当符文试图束缚该生物时，符文携带者的陆地速度承受 –20 尺减值，所有其他速度承受 –40 尺减值。若一名生物的飞行速度因此降至 0，其无法执行飞行或着陆动作。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.CJe2eWiKHOgv90j4]{Effect: Rovan, Seal of the Dead Vault Rune}

激发 （大地、无力化）符文携带者周围 10 尺辐射区域内的地面将永久变为困难地形，并且符文携带者必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|against:runesmith|traits:earth,incapacitation] 豁免，因为周围的大地试图将其包围并禁锢。该符文携带者随后在 24 小时内对你的 洛网，死之库封印 符文免疫。

大成功 携带者不受影响。

成功 携带者陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}，持续 1 轮。

失败 携带者陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}，持续 1 轮。

大失败 携带者陷入缓慢 2、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}，并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}，因为其被困入一个由大地压缩而成的巨大球体之中。若携带者无法在 3 轮内逃脱该球体，便会被石化。在一年的时间里，球体周围会形成一座小丘，掩埋其中的囚徒。在小丘顶部，留有一块刻有此符文图案的石头。反制该石头将解放囚徒。

Usage drawn on a creature

This mighty, jagged rune is just one of several that keeps the Destroyer sealed in his prison, deep in Golarion's core. The rune-bearer takes a –20-foot penalty to its land Speed and a –40-foot penalty to all other Speeds as the rune attempts to bind the creature. If a creature's fly Speed is reduced to 0 this way, it can't take the Fly or Arrest a Fall action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.CJe2eWiKHOgv90j4]{Effect: Rovan, Seal of the Dead Vault Rune}

Invocation (earth, incapacitation) The ground in a 10-foot emanation around the rune-bearer becomes difficult terrain permanently, and the rune-bearer must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:runesmith|traits:earth,incapacitation] saving throw as the earth around it attempts to surround and imprison it. The rune-bearer is then immune to your rovan, seal of the dead vault runes for 24 hours.

Critical Success The bearer is unaffected.

Success The bearer becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The bearer becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The bearer becomes slowed 2, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} as it becomes trapped in a massive, compressed sphere of earth. If the bearer is unable to escape the sphere within 3 rounds, it becomes petrified. Over the course of a year, the sphere forms a small hill around it, hiding its buried prisoner. At the top of the hill, a stone with the image of this rune remains. Counteracting the stone frees the prisoner.
